verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א מִדְבַּר־ יָ֑ם כְּסוּפ֤וֹת לַֽחֲלֹ֔ף בַּנֶּ֙גֶב֙ בָּ֔א מִמִּדְבָּ֣ר מֵאֶ֖רֶץ נוֹרָאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: maś·śā miḏ·bar- yām kə·sū·p̄ō·wṯ la·ḥă·lōp̄ ban·ne·ḡeḇ bā mim·miḏ·bār mê·’e·reṣ nō·w·rā·’āh
verses.literal: [This is] the burden against the Desert by the Sea Like whirlwinds sweeping through the Negev [an invader] comes from the desert from a land of terror

verses.original: קָשָׁ֖ה חָז֥וּת הֻגַּד־ לִ֑י הַבּוֹגֵ֤ד׀ בּוֹגֵד֙ וְהַשּׁוֹדֵ֣ד׀ שׁוֹדֵ֔ד עֲלִ֤י עֵילָם֙ צוּרִ֣י מָדַ֔י הִשְׁבַּֽתִּי׃ כָּל־ אַנְחָתָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: qā·šāh ḥā·zūṯ hug·gaḏ- lî hab·bō·w·ḡêḏ bō·w·ḡêḏ wə·haš·šō·w·ḏêḏ šō·w·ḏêḏ ‘ă·lî ‘ê·lām ṣū·rî mā·ḏay hiš·bat·tî kāl- ’an·ḥā·ṯāh
verses.literal: A dire vision is declared to me The traitor still betrays and the destroyer still destroys Go up O Elam Lay siege O Media I will put an end to all her groaning

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֗ן מָתְנַי֙ מָלְא֤וּ חַלְחָלָ֔ה צִירִ֣ים אֲחָז֔וּנִי כְּצִירֵ֖י יֽוֹלֵדָ֑ה נַעֲוֵ֣יתִי מִשְּׁמֹ֔עַ נִבְהַ֖לְתִּי מֵרְאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên mā·ṯə·nay mā·lə·’ū ḥal·ḥā·lāh ṣî·rîm ’ă·ḥā·zū·nî kə·ṣî·rê yō·w·lê·ḏāh na·‘ă·wê·ṯî miš·šə·mō·a‘ niḇ·hal·tî mê·rə·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Therefore . . . my body is filled with anguish Pain grips me like the pains of a woman in labor I am bewildered to hear I am dismayed to see

verses.original: לְבָבִ֔י תָּעָ֣ה פַּלָּצ֖וּת בִּֽעֲתָ֑תְנִי אֵ֚ת נֶ֣שֶׁף חִשְׁקִ֔י שָׂ֥ם לִ֖י לַחֲרָדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḇā·ḇî tā·‘āh pal·lā·ṣūṯ bi·‘ă·ṯā·ṯə·nî ’êṯ ne·šep̄ ḥiš·qî śām lî la·ḥă·rā·ḏāh
verses.literal: My heart falters fear makes me tremble - The twilight I desired has turned to horror

verses.original: עָרֹ֧ךְ הַשֻּׁלְחָ֛ן צָפֹ֥ה הַצָּפִ֖ית אָכ֣וֹל שָׁתֹ֑ה ק֥וּמוּ הַשָּׂרִ֖ים מִשְׁח֥וּ מָגֵֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·rōḵ haš·šul·ḥān ṣā·p̄ōh haṣ·ṣā·p̄îṯ ’ā·ḵō·wl šā·ṯōh qū·mū haś·śā·rîm miš·ḥū mā·ḡên
verses.literal: They prepare a table they lay out a carpet they eat they drink Rise up O princes oil the shields

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אֲדֹנָ֑י אָמַ֛ר אֵלַ֖י לֵ֚ךְ הַעֲמֵ֣ד הַֽמְצַפֶּ֔ה יַגִּֽיד׃ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִרְאֶ֖ה
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’ā·mar ’ê·lay lêḵ ha·‘ă·mêḏ ham·ṣap·peh yag·gîḏ ’ă·šer yir·’eh
verses.literal: For this [is what] the Lord says to me Go post a lookout [and] have him report what he sees

verses.original: וְרָ֣אָה רֶ֗כֶב צֶ֚מֶד פָּֽרָשִׁ֔ים רֶ֥כֶב חֲמ֖וֹר רֶ֣כֶב גָּמָ֑ל וְהִקְשִׁ֥יב קֶ֖שֶׁב רַב־ קָֽשֶׁב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’āh re·ḵeḇ ṣe·meḏ pā·rā·šîm re·ḵeḇ ḥă·mō·wr re·ḵeḇ gā·māl wə·hiq·šîḇ qe·šeḇ raḇ- qā·šeḇ
verses.literal: When he sees chariots with teams of horsemen riders on donkeys riders on camels he must be alert . . . fully alert

verses.original: אַרְיֵ֑ה וַיִּקְרָ֖א תָּמִיד֙ יוֹמָ֔ם אֲדֹנָ֗י אָנֹכִ֞י עֹמֵ֤ד עַל־ מִצְפֶּ֣ה׀ כָּל־ הַלֵּילֽוֹת׃ אָנֹכִ֥י נִצָּ֖ב וְעַל־ מִ֨שְׁמַרְתִּ֔י
verses.transliteration: ’ar·yêh way·yiq·rā tā·mîḏ yō·w·mām ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’ā·nō·ḵî ‘ō·mêḏ ‘al- miṣ·peh kāl- hal·lê·lō·wṯ ’ā·nō·ḵî niṣ·ṣāḇ wə·‘al- miš·mar·tî
verses.literal: Then the lookout shouted Day after day my lord I stand on the watchtower night after night I stay at my post

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה־ זֶ֥ה בָא֙ רֶ֣כֶב אִ֔ישׁ פָּֽרָשִׁ֑ים צֶ֖מֶד וַיַּ֣עַן וַיֹּ֗אמֶר נָפְלָ֤ה נָֽפְלָה֙ בָּבֶ֔ל וְכָל־ פְּסִילֵ֥י אֱלֹהֶ֖יהָ שִׁבַּ֥ר לָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh- zeh ḇā re·ḵeḇ ’îš pā·rā·šîm ṣe·meḏ way·ya·‘an way·yō·mer nā·p̄ə·lāh nā·p̄ə·lāh bā·ḇel wə·ḵāl pə·sî·lê ’ĕ·lō·he·hā šib·bar lā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Look here come the riders . . . horsemen in pairs And one answered saying Fallen fallen is Babylon All the images of her gods lie shattered on the ground

verses.original: וּבֶן־ מְדֻשָׁתִ֖י גָּרְנִ֑י הִגַּ֥דְתִּי לָכֶֽם׃ס אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי מֵאֵ֨ת יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇen- mə·ḏu·šā·ṯî gā·rə·nî hig·gaḏ·tî lā·ḵem ’ă·šer šā·ma‘·tî mê·’êṯ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: O my people crushed on the threshing floor I tell you what I have heard from the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א דּוּמָ֑ה קֹרֵ֣א אֵלַי֙ מִשֵּׂעִ֔יר שֹׁמֵר֙ מַה־ מִלַּ֔יְלָה שֹׁמֵ֖ר מַה־ מִלֵּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: maś·śā dū·māh qō·rê ’ê·lay miś·śê·‘îr šō·mêr mah- mil·lay·lāh šō·mêr mah- mil·lêl
verses.literal: [This is] the burden against Dumah One calls to me from Seir Watchman what is left of the night Watchman what is left of the night

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֔ר אָמַ֣ר בֹ֖קֶר אָתָ֥ה וְגַם־ לָ֑יְלָה אִם־ תִּבְעָי֥וּן בְּעָ֖יוּ אֵתָֽיוּ׃ס שֻׁ֥בוּ
verses.transliteration: šō·mêr ’ā·mar ḇō·qer ’ā·ṯāh wə·ḡam- lā·yə·lāh ’im- tiḇ·‘ā·yūn bə·‘ā·yū ’ê·ṯā·yū šu·ḇū
verses.literal: The watchman replies Morning has come but also the night If you would inquire then inquire Come back yet again

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א בַּעְרָ֑ב בַּיַּ֤עַר בַּעְרַב֙ תָּלִ֔ינוּ אֹֽרְח֖וֹת דְּדָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: maś·śā ba‘·rāḇ bay·ya·‘ar ba‘·raḇ tā·lî·nū ’ō·rə·ḥō·wṯ də·ḏā·nîm
verses.literal: [This is] the burden against Arabia In the thickets of Arabia you must lodge O caravans of Dedanites

verses.original: לִקְרַ֥את הֵתָ֣יוּ מָ֑יִם צָמֵ֖א יֹשְׁבֵי֙ אֶ֣רֶץ תֵּימָ֔א קִדְּמ֥וּ נֹדֵֽד׃ בְּלַחְמ֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: liq·raṯ hê·ṯā·yū mā·yim ṣā·mê yō·šə·ḇê ’e·reṣ tê·mā qid·də·mū nō·ḏêḏ bə·laḥ·mōw
verses.literal: - Bring water for the thirsty O dwellers vvv of Tema meet the refugees with food

verses.original: כִּֽי־ נָדָ֑דוּ מִפְּנֵ֥י חֲרָב֖וֹת מִפְּנֵ֣י׀ חֶ֣רֶב נְטוּשָׁ֗ה וּמִפְּנֵי֙ קֶ֣שֶׁת דְּרוּכָ֔ה וּמִפְּנֵ֖י כֹּ֥בֶד מִלְחָמָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- nā·ḏā·ḏū mip·pə·nê ḥă·rā·ḇō·wṯ mip·pə·nê ḥe·reḇ nə·ṭū·šāh ū·mip·pə·nê qe·šeṯ də·rū·ḵāh ū·mip·pə·nê kō·ḇeḏ mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: For they flee from the sword . . . the sword that is drawn from the bow that is bent and from the stress of battle

verses.original: כִּי־ כֹ֛ה אֲדֹנָ֖י אָמַ֥ר אֵלָ֑י בְּע֤וֹד שָׁנָה֙ שָׂכִ֔יר כִּשְׁנֵ֣י כָּל־ כְּב֥וֹד קֵדָֽר׃ וְכָלָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’ā·mar ’ê·lāy bə·‘ō·wḏ šā·nāh śā·ḵîr kiš·nê kāl- kə·ḇō·wḏ qê·ḏār wə·ḵā·lāh
verses.literal: For this [is what] the Lord says to me . . . Within one year as a hired worker would count [it] all the glory of Kedar will be gone

verses.original: וּשְׁאָ֧ר מִסְפַּר־ קֶ֛שֶׁת גִּבּוֹרֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־ קֵדָ֖ר יִמְעָ֑טוּ כִּ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל דִּבֵּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·’ār mis·par- qe·šeṯ gib·bō·w·rê ḇə·nê- qê·ḏār yim·‘ā·ṭū kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- yiś·rā·’êl dib·bêr
verses.literal: The remaining . . . archers the warriors - of Kedar will be few For the LORD the God of Israel has spoken
